properties.label: SA-009 / div-before-mul: PSM spend never over-pays, never under-approves
properties.claimUnderTest: usdsSpent = gemAmt*conv*(WAD+tout)/WAD is integer-identical to the Sky DssLitePsm._buyGem pull (gemAmt*conv + floor(gemAmt*conv*tout/WAD)); it never under-approves (buyGem cannot revert for short allowance), never over-pays vs the pull (gap == 0), never spends more than the swept balance, and any leftover that parks on the contract is dust (< one gem's cost). Favors protocol.
properties.verdict: REFUTATION-UPHELD (property holds; SA-009 is a non-finding)
properties.verdictBasis: forge-fuzz (exact in-contract division expressions, 100k runs PASS) + closed-form analytic proof; Halmos full-symbolic INCONCLUSIVE by tool limitation (TIMEOUT, no counterexample at any scale).

halmosTests.name: check_psmSpend_identityEqualsPull
halmosTests.note: Division-free Euclidean encoding of usdsSpent==pull. Z3 exhausts model-search; never returns SAT.

halmosTests.name: check_psmSpend_floorBoundsAreDust
halmosTests.note: Division-free encoding of usdsSpent<=usdsAmount and leftover==rsp+rg < D+WAD (dust). Z3 exhausts model-search; never returns SAT.

forgeFuzzTest.name: testFuzz_psmSpend_exactExprNeverOverpays
forgeFuzzTest.exercises: the LITERAL source arithmetic: gemAmt = usdsAmount*WAD/(conv*(WAD+tout)); usdsSpent = gemAmt*conv*(WAD+tout)/WAD; pull = gemAmt*conv + (gemAmt*conv*tout)/WAD
forgeFuzzTest.domain: tout in [0,1e16], conv in [1,1e12], usdsAmount in [1,1e30], gemAmt>0

properties.analyticProof: Let A=gemAmt*conv. usdsSpent = floor(A*(WAD+tout)/WAD) = floor((A*WAD + A*tout)/WAD). Since A*WAD is exactly divisible by WAD, the floor distributes: = A + floor(A*tout/WAD), which is EXACTLY the DssLitePsm pull (A + floor(A*tout/WAD)). Hence gap == 0 (never under-approves, never over-pays). gemAmt = floor(usdsAmount*WAD/(conv*(WAD+tout))) is the floor, so gemAmt*conv*(WAD+tout) <= usdsAmount*WAD, giving usdsSpent <= usdsAmount (no over-spend / no value leak). With rg = usdsAmount*WAD - gemAmt*D (< D) and rsp = gemAmt*D - usdsSpent*WAD (< WAD), (usdsAmount-usdsSpent)*WAD = rg + rsp < D + WAD, i.e. leftover is bounded by one gem-unit of cost (dust).

properties.label: FAITH-001 / L-02: setRatio reachable post-state is exactly [0,50]
properties.claimUnderTest: setRatio reverts only on ratio > MAX_RATIO(50), so ratio==50 is settable despite NatSpec ('strictly < MAX_RATIO', 'Max settable ratio is MAX_RATIO-1'=49). Reachable set is exactly ratio in [0,50] (50 inclusive reachable, 51 not), bounded (not unbounded).
properties.verdictBasis: Halmos symbolic execution of the REAL contract (not a mirror), over all uint8 inputs.

halmosTests.name: check_setRatio_allows50
halmosTests.proves: ratio == 50 is reachable (setRatio(50) succeeds), contradicting the 'strictly < 50' NatSpec.

halmosTests.name: check_setRatio_rejects51
halmosTests.proves: setRatio(51) reverts (RatioTooHigh) and leaves ratio unchanged -> 51 is unreachable.

halmosTests.name: check_setRatio_reachableSetIsZeroTo50
halmosTests.proves: for ALL uint8 newRatio: succeeds iff newRatio<=50 storing exactly newRatio, reverts for 51..255; post-state ratio is ALWAYS in [0,50] (bounded).

properties.conclusion: The doc/code off-by-one is confirmed: code allows ratio==50 while NatSpec advertises a strict < 50 (max 49). Impact is bounded — the reachable ceiling is 50 (a 50% mint-debt ratio), not unbounded. Consistent with the L-02 severity. Downstream consumers must treat ratio <= 50, not < 50.

halmosLimitationNote: Halmos (bitvector backend) cannot decide any WAD=1e18-scaled floor relationship with symbolic operands. Empirically on this codebase: multiplication-only queries (x*y==y*x) PASS instantly; `fee/1e18` with fee<=2e18 (result in {0,1,2}) TIMES OUT; even the trivial `b*WAD==sp*WAD+rs, rs<WAD => sp==b` TIMES OUT at b<=1e9. Root cause: 256-bit BV multiplication wraps mod 2^256, forcing Z3 into intractable overflow case-analysis to relate k*WAD to k. This is independent of whether the floor is written with the DIV opcode or re-encoded division-free via the Euclidean identity. Critically, every run TIMED OUT in model-search and NEVER returned SAT — i.e. no counterexample exists/was found at any tractable scale, and a degenerate near-zero-fee slice PASSES symbolically (~5s). The Property-1 conclusion (refutation upheld) therefore rests on the 100k-run forge fuzz over the exact source expressions plus the closed-form proof; the Halmos checks are retained as the machine-checkable symbolic spec and as evidence of no counterexample.
